# nemau kubernetes node-pool add

Add a node pool to a running cluster.

The node size is either --flavor (an organization flavor) or all three of
--vcpus, --ram and --disk. --class is the node class the ClusterClass defines;
the console's default pool uses "default-worker".

## Usage

```
nemau kubernetes node-pool add <cluster> <name> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
nemau k8s node-pool add prod batch --class default-worker \
  --vcpus 4 --ram 8192 --disk 50 --replicas 2

nemau k8s node-pool add prod gpu --class default-worker --flavor <flavor-id> \
  --autoscaler-min 1 --autoscaler-max 5 --replicas 1
```

## Options

```
      --autoscaler-max int   autoscaler upper bound
      --autoscaler-min int   autoscaler lower bound
      --class string         node class defined by the ClusterClass (required)
      --disk int             disk in GB per node
      --flavor string        node flavor
      --ram int              memory in MB per node
      --replicas int         number of nodes, 0 to 100
      --vcpus int            vCPUs per node
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
